items.title: 魯比奧稱，伊朗在與伊朗的僵局中錯失了多次達成核協議的機會。
items.titleEn: Rubio says Tehran missed 'multiple' chances for nuclear deal amid Iran stalemate
items.titleZh: 魯比奧稱，伊朗在與伊朗的僵局中錯失了多次達成核協議的機會。
items.summaryEn: Iran has failed to take advantage of "multiple opportunities" to reach a deal on its nuclear program, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Wednesday.
items.summaryZh: 美國國務卿馬可·盧比奧週三表示，伊朗未能抓住「多次機會」就其核子計畫達成協議。

items.title: 標普500指數創歷史新高，油價與殖利率走低：即時更新
items.titleEn: S&P 500 rises to record high as oil and yields move lower: Live updates
items.titleZh: 標普500指數創歷史新高，油價與殖利率走低：即時更新
items.summaryEn: The S&P 500 rose to a fresh all-time intraday high on Tuesday, boosted by gains in key technology names as well as declines in oil prices and Treasury yields.
items.summaryZh: 週二，受主要科技股上漲以及油價和國債殖利率下跌的提振，標普500指數盤中創下歷史新高。

items.title: 交易員等待本週數據和聯準會會議紀要，國債殖利率上升
items.titleEn: Treasury yields rise as traders await data, Fed minutes this week
items.titleZh: 交易員等待本週數據和聯準會會議紀要，國債殖利率上升
items.summaryEn: U.S. Treasury yields are coming off a sharp selloff as investors look ahead to the Federal Reserve's last meeting minutes.
items.summaryZh: 美國公債殖利率在經歷大幅拋售後出現回升，投資人正密切關注聯準會上次會議紀要。

items.title: 一次「怪異」的IPO撤市、受損的聲譽以及人工智慧可穿戴設備未能實現突破的契機
items.titleEn: A 'weird' IPO pull, a tainted reputation and the stalled breakout moment for AI wearables
items.titleZh: 一次「怪異」的IPO撤市、受損的聲譽以及人工智慧可穿戴設備未能實現突破的契機
items.summaryEn: Apple, Google and Meta are pushing new AI devices and assistants amid growing privacy concerns around wearables.
items.summaryZh: 在人們對穿戴式裝置隱私問題的日益關注下，蘋果、谷歌和 Meta 等公司正在大力推廣新的人工智慧裝置和助理。

items.title: 大衛·埃里森剛剛聘請了一位聯合首席執行官來管理他的新帝國：他是伊農·克雷茲。
items.titleEn: David Ellison just brought in a co-CEO to run his new empire: Meet Ynon Kreiz
items.titleZh: 大衛·埃里森剛剛聘請了一位聯合首席執行官來管理他的新帝國：他是伊農·克雷茲。
items.summaryEn: Ynon Kreiz's appointment as co-CEO of Skydance answers a key governance question for Ellison's soon-to-be-merged company.
items.summaryZh: Ynon Kreiz 被任命為 Skydance 的聯合首席執行官，這解答了 Ellison 即將合併的公司的關鍵治理問題。

items.title: 9月勞動市場疲軟，新增就業人數僅2.9萬個，失業率升至4.2%。
items.titleEn: Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%
items.titleZh: 9月勞動市場疲軟，新增就業人數僅2.9萬個，失業率升至4.2%。
items.summaryEn: Nonfarm payrolls rose by just 29,000 in September, well below the 84,000 forecast, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.2%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said.
items.summaryZh: 美國勞工統計局表示，9月非農就業人數僅增加2.9萬人，遠低於先前預測的8.4萬人，失業率升至4.2%。
